scientific_limitations: The result is for canonical unit-diagonal inclusions with the full Luxemburg Nakano norm, not all multipliers, other modulars or the separable heart. The boundary convergence of the exponent series is irrelevant. Monotonicity is assumed only for the limsup simplification. Earlier general measure-of-noncompactness formulations may carry unresolved historical-priority risk.
title: An abscissa law for exact essential norms of \(\ell_1\)-to-Nakano embeddings
